entries.description: Security reminders applied during Kubernetes manifest generation: avoid broad privileges in pods, prefer explicit container ports and label selectors, keep sensitive values out of plain Secret manifests committed to version control.
decision_rules: Never set privileged: true or allow broad RBAC permissions (* verbs on resources)
Always specify explicit containerPort values and label selectors in Deployment and Service
Use External Secrets Operator or Sealed Secrets — avoid committing base64-encoded secrets in plain Secret manifests
anti_patterns: Using privileged: true in pod specs — grants full kernel access
Committing Kubernetes Secret manifests with base64-encoded sensitive values to git
Using wildcard RBAC verbs (verbs: ["*"]) or wildcard resources
